query: Which adversarial robustness tests (SNR levels, overlapping speech, code-switching, synthetic TTS) and failure thresholds should trigger dataset expansion or model retraining?

response.query: Which adversarial robustness tests (SNR levels, overlapping speech, code-switching, synthetic TTS) and failure thresholds should trigger dataset expansion or model retraining?
response.answer: Dataset expansion or model retraining should be triggered when adversarial robustness tests reveal SNR levels below 10 dB, overlapping speech detection fails 75% of the time, code-switching errors exceed 5%, or synthetic TTS inaccuracies surpass 3%.
